segments.title: The first necks could BARELY move
segments.say: The first necks in history could barely move.

segments.title: Meet Tiktaalik
segments.sub: A fish with a neck, **375 million years** ago
segments.say: Meet Tiktaalik, a fish with a neck, about three hundred seventy-five million years ago.

segments.title: Side to side? About 5°
segments.say: Scientists modelled it. Sideways, about five degrees. Upward, about two. Big twists were not possible.

segments.title: So why a NECK?
segments.sub: To free the **shoulders** for front limbs
segments.say: So why a neck? Probably to free the shoulders as the front limbs took on more work.

segments.title: Tested with sturgeon spines
segments.say: The team measured spines of living sturgeon to model six fossil animals.
Follow for Weird Animal number 21 tonight.
